verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at developers.make.com that indexes the Developer Hub with links to .md pages. Make also publishes Make Skills, Markdown files built for AI assistants doing Make-specific tasks. Together these give an agent a direct, agent-oriented documentation entry point. missing for 10: llms.txt coverage of the help.make.com help center, a working .md variant for every doc page (the api-documentation.md probe returned Page Not Found), independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developers.make.com/llms.txt # Make Developer Hub

Make Skills are Markdown files that help your assistant reliably perform Make-specific tasks, including building scenarios, configuring modules, and connecting to Make MCP server or third-party services.
